name: stitched-text-draw
title: Stitched Text Draw
description: Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Uppercased А-Я, Ё, A-Z, 0-9, space and . , ! ? : - –. Words wrap into lines; the thread never thins under 4 px.

variables.label: Stitch
variables.description: Dash/gap scale, thread width, and jitter amplitude.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the stitched word holds until the frame cuts.
